source_title: Narragansett Bancorp, Inc. Announces Expected Closing Date of Initial Public Offering
source_excerpt:
SWANSEA, Mass. , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Narragansett Bancorp, Inc. (the "Company"), the proposed holding company for BayCoast Bank (the "Bank"), announced today that all final regulatory approvals have been received to complete the Bank's two-tier holding company reorganization and the Company's related stock offering.
The transaction is expected to close on Monday, November 2, 2026. The Company's common stock is expected to begin trading on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the symbol "NARA" beginning on Monday, November 2, 2026.
The Company expects to sell 9,098,800 shares of common stock, which includes 761,760 shares to be sold to the Bank's Employee Stock Ownership Plan, and represents the adjusted maximum of the offering range as disclosed in the Company's prospectus dated August 11, 2026. The Company will also issue 11,638,000 shares of common stock to Narragansett Financial Corporation, the Company's mutual holding company, and will issue 423,200 shares of common stock to BayCoast Charitable Foundation, Inc. The Company expects to have 21,160,000 shares of common stock issued and outstanding upon the closing of the transaction.
The stock offering was oversubscribed by depositors of the Bank as of May 31, 2025. Accordingly, valid stock orders received in the subscription offering will be filled according to the purchase limitations and proration methods disclosed in the Company's prospectus dated August 11, 2026. Persons wishing to confirm their stock orders may do so by contacting the Stock Information Center at (844) 301-2265, beginning Friday, October 30, 2026, at 10:00 a.m., Eastern Time. The Stock Information Center is open between Monday through Friday between 10:00 a.m. and 4:00 p.m., Eastern Time.
The Company's transfer agent, Continental Stock Transfer & Trust Company, plans to mail Direct Registration System ("DRS") book-entry statements for the shares purchased in the stock offering, and interest checks, on or about November 4, 2026.
Piper Sandler & Co. acted as marketing agent for the Company in connection with the stock offering. Luse Gorman, PC served as legal counsel to the Company and the Bank in connection with the stock offering. Covington & Burling LLP served as legal counsel to Piper Sandler & Co. in connection with the stock offering.
Originally chartered in 1851, BayCoast Bank is a Massachusetts-chartered stock savings bank that operates from its main office and 25 full-service branch banking offices in the South Coast of Massachusetts and the State of Rhode Island, as well as two loan production offices in Massachusetts and Rhode Island. BayCoast Bank's deposits are insured in full beyond federal deposit insurance coverage limits by the Depositors Insurance Fund.
The shares of common stock are not deposits or savings accounts and are not insured or guaranteed by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation, the Depositors Insurance Fund or any other governmental agency.
